card.title: DANZIG
card.text: The Free City of Danzig was captured by German forces at the start of the war.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Westerplatte in the harbor of Danzig was one of the first battles in Germany's invasion of Poland, marking the start of World War II in Europe. Germany held the city until at the end of the war when it was liberated by Soviet forces.

value.value: JOINT OPERATION is a strong removal order. You can maximize its value by having many different unit types on the battlefield, but sometimes it is best to use it finish off a damaged enemy unit.

value.value: Many German cards, such as COMBINED ARMS, become stronger the more unit types you have on the battlefield. It is sometimes better to deploy a new unit type rather than add a second one of a type you already have. Infantry and artillery are examples of unit types.
